items.title: SWS: More Pinoys fall victim to cybercrimes
items.description: ore Filipinos have fallen victim to cybercrimes in the second quarter of the year, according to a new survey by Social Weather Stations.

items.title: DepEd taps 170  leaders to boost SHS graduates’ employability
items.description: The Department of Education  has tapped the assistance of more than 170 leaders across government, industry and strategic economic sectors in implementing the work immersion program under the Strengthened Senior High School curriculum to improve the employability of graduates.

items.title: Ferry fire death toll hits 77
items.description: One of the survivors of the MV June Aster fire has died in a hospital in Palawan, the Philippine Coast Guard  said yesterday.

items.title: 14 Pinoys ‘recruited’ by Russia for Ukraine war
items.description: Fourteen Filipinos were reportedly recruited in Russia and lured into combat roles for its war against Ukraine, a security expert said yesterday.

items.title: DBM: 94.1% of 2026 budget released
items.description: The Marcos administration has released roughly 94.1 percent of the P6.793-trillion national budget as of end-August, a slightly slower pace than the previous year’s, the Department of Budget and Management said.

items.title: Escudero hits prosecutors for violating sub judice rule
items.description: Presiding officer Sen. Francis Escudero yesterday issued show-cause orders against members of the House prosecution panel amid alleged violation of the sub judice ruling in the ongoing impeachment trial against Vice President Sara Duterte.

items.title: Fluid vote threshold open to abuse – Azcuna
items.description: A changeable vote threshold can be easily manipulated by ruling political factions, retired Supreme Court associate justice Adolfo Azcuna warned yesterday, as he defended maintaining the required votes needed to convict an impeachable official at two-thirds of all 24 senators.

items.title: Panganiban to Risa: You’re single... I’m single
items.description: Retired chief justice Artemio Panganiban drew some uncomfortable laughter in the plenary yesterday after teasing Sen. Risa Hontiveros.

items.title: House adopts Senate bill on BSKE
items.description: In a move to hasten the process, the House of Representatives has decided to adopt the approved measure of the Senate providing five-year terms for barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan officials as the BSK elections on Nov. 2 draw near.

items.title: Romualdez pleads not guilty in P7.4 billion plunder case
items.description: Leyte representative and former speaker Martin Romualdez has pleaded not guilty to plunder charges over his alleged P7.4-billion kickbacks from flood control projects.
